title: The Weather Modification Efficacy-Culpability Superposition — Notice-Only Seeding Contracts, Slutsky Tort Causation Bars, and Parametric Weather Derivatives — Structural Contract (v1.0)
description: Deterministic structural contract for the weather modification efficacy-culpability superposition. Encodes EQ_01 statistical masking inside natural interannual variance (Delta_mu = 12.0% inside sigma_nat = 24.0%, SNR_1 = 0.50, N_min = 15.3664 instrumented seasons to clear a two-sided z = 1.96 causation bar), EQ_02 the efficacy-culpability superposition spread (P_contract = 2400000 plus V_param = 4500000 gross inflow against suppressed p_tort = 0.04 on D_ext = 35000000, E[L_tort] = 1400000, S_super = +5500000, with the 15 U.S.C. Section 330d notice-only fine capped at 10000), and EQ_03 the 2026 attribution-science phase transition (p_tort* = 0.51 preponderance bar drives E[L_tort]' = 17850000 and inverts operator net payoff to -10950000, collapsing the notice-only shield).

theorem_1_statistical_masking_natural_va.description: EQ_01: a claimed seeding precipitation shift buried inside natural interannual variance yields a sub-unity single-season signal-to-noise ratio, so a downstream tort plaintiff needs many consecutive instrumented seasons to isolate anthropogenic causation at the 95% confidence bar.

delta_mu_pct.description: Claimed seeding precipitation yield shift Delta_mu (percent).

sigma_nat_pct.description: Natural interannual precipitation standard deviation sigma_nat (percent).

snr_single_season.description: Single-season signal-to-noise ratio SNR_1 = Delta_mu / sigma_nat.

z_threshold_95pct.description: Two-sided z statistic for the 95% confidence evidentiary threshold.

seasons_required_95pct.description: N_min = (z / SNR_1)^2 consecutive instrumented seasons to isolate anthropogenic causation.

masking_holds.description: True when SNR_1 < 1 and N_min > 1, so a single season cannot clear the causation bar.

theorem_2_efficacy_culpability_superposi.description: EQ_02: the operator sells commercial efficacy (municipal seeding fee plus parametric derivative payout) while invoking Slutsky and the sub-unity SNR to suppress tort recovery probability, capturing a positive net arbitrage spread against downstream flood/drought damages under a notice-only statutory regime.

cme_degree_day_multiplier_usd.description: CME Group heating/cooling degree-day index point multiplier (USD per HDD/CDD point).

parametric_index_points.description: Parametric derivative notional in HDD/CDD index points: V_param / multiplier.

v_param_usd.description: Parametric weather derivative hedge payout V_param.

p_tort.description: Suppressed downstream tort recovery probability under Slutsky and SNR_1 = 0.50.

d_ext_usd.description: Downstream flood/drought external damage magnitude D_ext.

e_l_tort_usd.description: Expected tort liability E[L_tort] = p_tort * D_ext.

statutory_nonreporting_max_fine_usd.description: Maximum statutory fine for non-reporting under 15 U.S.C. Section 330d.

s_super_usd.description: Net superposition spread S_super = (P_contract + V_param) - E[L_tort].

spread_positive.description: True when S_super > 0, so the operator arbitrages a positive spread.

theorem_3_attribution_phase_transition_c.description: EQ_03: when isotopic tracer telemetry and ensemble attribution models push proximate-cause probability across the preponderance bar, expected liability jumps and the operator net payoff inverts negative, collapsing the notice-only statutory shield.

d_ext_usd.description: Downstream flood/drought external damage magnitude D_ext.

e_l_tort_post_usd.description: Post-attribution expected liability E[L_tort]' = p_tort* * D_ext.

gross_inflow_usd.description: Gross commercial inflow P_contract + V_param carried from EQ_02.

net_pnl_post_usd.description: Post-attribution operator net payoff (P_contract + V_param) - E[L_tort]'.

superposition_collapses.description: True when the post-attribution net payoff inverts strictly negative.

notice_only_shield_collapses.description: True when p_tort* > 0.5 and the superposition collapses, piercing the 15 U.S.C. Section 330 notice-only regime.
